rdfs:label: language
rdfs:comment: A language of the resource — typically a BCP 47 tag.
notes: Use BCP 47 language tags as values (`"en"`, `"en-US"`, `"de-CH"`). For multilingual resources, repeat. JSON-LD documents can also express language directly on string literals via `@language` — this property is for declaring the resource's overall language(s). `urn:solid:inLanguage` is the schema.org equivalent; `urn:solid:hasLanguage`/`urn:solid:knowsLanguage` describe languages a person speaks, not a resource's language.

history.note: Added notToBeConfusedWith inLanguage/hasLanguage/knowsLanguage; seeAlso replaces vcard:hasLanguage with urn:solid:LinguisticSystem.
